newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia noon rubber barely changed, trading thin.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia noon rubber barely changed, trading thin.

text.p: Malaysian rubber prices were barely changed at noon session after a slow morning trade, with prices expected to move down due to lack of demand.
Dealers said overseas buyers continued to stay at the sidelines while waiting for cheaper prices.
"Buyers are still holding back. They are still waiting," a dealer said.
"How long are they going to wait?" he asked, adding that "prices here are much cheaper than in Thailand, after government intervention, and in Indonesia."
